multi_entity_note: Two parties: golfer Tom Watson (Consultant) and Adams Golf, Ltd., with separate notice addresses.
processing_note: Payment shall be made to ADAMS GOLF within one month following the end of the calendar year.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading names the contract "ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT".

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is "entered into on January 13, 2005", and both signatures are dated the same day.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The term commences the 1st day of September 2004, which Section 18 restates as September 1, 2004 for the entire term.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The termination date of the term is redacted ("[*****] day of [*****]"), so no expiry date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 25 says the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Kansas; the other Kansas mentions are the arbitration venue and an address.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has no renewal provision; the listed periods are cure, payment and termination periods.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal, so there is no notice period to prevent renewal; the periods are termination and cure notices.
